Interface GameState

All Known Implementing Classes:
ActionResolutionState, EndRoundState, GameOverState, PausedState, PositioningState, SetupState
public interface GameState
State pattern interface: each game phase validates and handles actions differently. GameController delegates to the current state.

      void handleAction(GameController context, PlayerAction action)

    • onCurrentPlayerDisconnected

      default void onCurrentPlayerDisconnected(GameController context)
      FA3: invoked when a player disconnects while the game is running, so a turn-based state can advance past the active player if it was them. Default: no-op (states that are not turn-based ignore it).
      Parameters:
      context - the GameController
